assessment_objectives.objective: aggregated Control Assurance Automation (CAA) telemetry is assessed to determine whether aggregation elevates its sensitivity above that of the individual source data.

aggregated Control Assurance Automation (CAA) telemetry is assigned a classification commensurate with its assessed aggregated sensitivity in accordance with the organization's data classification scheme.

aggregated Control Assurance Automation (CAA) telemetry is protected in accordance with the handling requirements for its assigned classification, including access restriction, encryption and logging of access.
the classification of aggregated Control Assurance Automation (CAA) telemetry is reviewed at a defined frequency and when new data sources are added to the aggregation.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change
